summary.ja: 節点でδᵢⱼとなるLagrange基底により、関数を節点値から補間する。公開実装は区間のGLL/等間隔節点、三角形P1/P2、四角形Qₚの積基底と、GLLの厳密質量・求積集中質量の差を扱う。
summary.en: Interpolate from nodal values with Lagrange cardinal functions. The example covers interval GLL/equispaced nodes, triangle P1/P2, quadrilateral Qₚ products, and exact versus GLL-quadrature-lumped mass.

code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Teukolsky, S. A. (2015). Short note on the mass matrix for Gauss–Lobatto grid points.
references.scope: GLL nodal cardinal basis and the rank-one difference between exact and quadrature-lumped interval mass matrices; not a universal triangle mass formula.

supports.ja: GLL節点のLagrange基底と、厳密質量行列・対角求積質量行列の差を参照する。三角形一般への公式とはしない。
supports.en: Supports GLL cardinal functions and exact versus quadrature-lumped interval mass; not a universal triangle formula.

verification.locator: Author preprint: Section 2, equations (1)–(18), and Section 3.1, equations (19)–(23); journal DOI/year/pages checked against publisher metadata.

assumptions: Interval nodes must be distinct finite real values at modest degree; cardinal polynomials are evaluated through a Legendre Vandermonde solve.
For p≥1, GLL nodes are ±1 and roots of Pₚ′. A p+1-point GLL rule is exact through degree 2p−1, not generally for degree-2p mass products.
Triangle functions are only P1/P2 on (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). Quadrilaterals use Qₚ tensor products with (p+1)² degrees of freedom.
units: Reference coordinates/basis values are dimensionless; nodal values carry the function's units. Affine interval matrices scale as M∝J and K∝1/J with J=L/2.
boundary_conditions: GLL includes endpoints but does not itself enforce Dirichlet values or interelement continuity. The consuming discretization supplies values, fluxes and coupling.

limitations.ja: 高次数のVandermonde解法は条件数の制約を受け、安定なbarycentric表作成や汎用高次要素の代替ではない。等間隔節点の高次補間にはRunge現象がある。GLL集中質量と厳密質量のrank-1差は重み1・アフィン区間での結果で、三角形全般へ適用しない。
limitations.en: High-degree Vandermonde solves face conditioning limits and are not a replacement for stable barycentric tabulation or a general high-order element library. High-degree equispaced interpolation can exhibit Runge behavior. The rank-one exact/lumped GLL mass difference concerns the unweighted affine interval, not arbitrary triangles.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 区間節点は相異なる有限実数で、中程度の次数を想定する。区間のLagrange多項式はLegendre Vandermonde行列を解いて評価する。
p≥1のGLL節点は両端±1とPₚ′の根。p+1点GLL求積は2p−1次まで厳密で、次数2pの質量積分は一般には厳密でない。
三角形は (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) のP1またはP2のみ。四角形は区間基底のQₚ積で、自由度数は(p+1)²。
units_ja: 参照座標と基底は無次元、節点値は表す関数の単位。アフィン区間行列はJ=L/2により M∝J、K∝1/J。
boundary_conditions_ja: GLLは端点を含むが、それだけでDirichlet値や要素間の連続性を課すわけではない。境界値・流束・接続は利用側が指定する。

problem.ja: 節点値からの多項式補間、微分と参照要素行列。
problem.en: Polynomial interpolation/differentiation from nodal values and reference-element matrices.

variant.en: Interval Lagrange bases via a Legendre Vandermonde solve, GLL/equispaced nodes, explicit triangle P1/P2 and Qₚ products.

en: Studying nodal degrees of freedom, partition of unity and modal equivalence.
Comparing quadrature-diagonalized GLL mass with exact mass.

en: Arbitrary-degree triangles, curved elements or large high-degree tabulation.
Treating GLL diagonal quadrature mass as universally exact.
